note: McCulloch County publishes no zoning districts layer; its portal lists no GIS services. The largest city, Brady, publishes Zoning Ordinance 1145 and a Zoning Map on its Planning & Zoning page, apparently as a document, not a queryable service. ArcGIS searches for McCulloch and Brady found only parcel, precinct and unrelated layers. The generic Zoning_Districts service checked is Fairbanks, Alaska, not this county.
